chunk_text: Engineering Memory is an evidence-grounded engineering knowledge system for heavy machinery / hydraulic excavator maintenance. A technician selects a machine, enters symptoms and optional hydraulic conditions, and receives ranked historical cases, likely causes, supporting evidence, recommended inspection and previous successful resolution. Core flow: Frontend → FastAPI → BGE embedding → FAISS retrieval → diagnosis engine → structured result → Frontend. • Qwen/local LLM is optional for the first working prototype. Do not let its download block development. • UCI hydraulic data is a hydraulic test-rig benchmark, not real excavator data. Label it correctly. • Demo machine/case records are prototype data, not real Tata Hitachi records. • Diagnosis is decision support, not confirmation of the physical root cause.
